entries.text: Icons for the update settings on the About page
Pause live updates on desktop while the screen is asleep or locked
Install macOS updates from inside the app
Pick a request list's status from a menu with counts, and read each record as one line with its labels after it
Proxy groups unfold smoothly as one block
Status filters on the request lists say when they have nothing instead of showing no search results
Larger status filters above the request lists
Connection, request, DNS, outbound IP and log details use smaller text with more room
List rows follow a smaller text size, as they already did a larger one
The phone tab bar spaces five tabs and sets out icons and labels as iOS does
On phones, Requests joins the tab bar while HTTP capture is on
The automatic update check and the update channel moved from General settings to the About page
Filter logs from a button beside search
Set the log level from the Logs page

Connections become Requests: connections by minute with All, Active and Failed counts, conditions on app, exit, rule or protocol, a timeline for each connection, DNS queries, segments that keep their place, and new rows held under a desktop pointer
Choose between stable and prerelease updates in the settings
Lists and cards share one set of margins, so rows line up across pages
The dashboard's outbound mode card is titled Outbound, leaving its mode buttons more room
Grouped lists match iOS 27: row heights, margins, corners and section spacing
On desktop, Logs moves from the sidebar into Tools
Connections on macOS, Windows and Linux show the icon of the app that made them
Requests sits right after Proxies in the desktop sidebar
Connections that failed to connect now show in the requests list, with the reason
Update from this fork's releases, download automatically and install on exit
When an update has no file to download, the app opens the release page to download it by hand
Open a log's details to select and copy it on a phone
Enable automatic resource updates by default
Let open rows be disabled and toggle rows carry a subtitle and be disabled
Open scripts and global added rules from the extend page's own rows and bars
Release files carry the core line and the full version, as in FlClash-dev-0.9.4-windows-amd64-setup.exe
Added rules can go to custom exits, each set to its own target on the profile's extension page
Bypass <local> by default on new Windows installs
Update the core to mihomo v1.19.34; the config editor completes Snell v6, multi-user shadowsocks listeners and the mieru listener's tcp-idle-timeout
Add respect-rules, hosts and cache-algorithm to the DNS overrides
Set the macOS system DNS through tun.dns-mode native
The dashboard status button shows a count or download progress, and its cards cycle and confirm in place
Windows and Intel Macs render with Impeller, and the Apple Silicon macOS download no longer carries Intel code
Gather the core, update and resource statuses into one dashboard button whose cards open like an alert
Run a profile's extend script and its added rules together
New dashboard icons for service status and proxy groups
Show the auto download and install toggles after the update channel
Even spacing for the update settings on the About page and a rounder, larger delay test icon on proxy cards
Navigation bar tabs fit their titles, and a tap near a tab's edge selects it
Live connections on the dashboard open on the active ones
The rule type picker shows rule types as profiles write them, and rule search finds a rule by that name, such as DOMAIN-KEYWORD
Rule lists show rule types as profiles write them, such as DOMAIN-KEYWORD instead of DOMAIN_KEYWORD
Cap the five-destination dock at the widest iPhone's row
The prerelease update check finds the newest release behind many releases of other lines, and the update card names the installed prerelease, not only its X.Y.Z
A stop whose answer is lost with the connection to the core no longer turns the proxy back on when the core comes back
Restarting the core with TUN on no longer hangs when it has to ask for authorization again
On desktop, a restart asked for while the core is still starting, such as after installing the helper, now restarts it, and the core can start again after a start whose local connection setup hung
On Android, stopping while the core is still starting no longer leaves it running, and a start that failed while sending settings to the core no longer blocks the next start
Space out automatic service rechecks
Recheck watched service failures with backoff
Service checks recover automatically when a chain switches to a working front proxy
Dashboard checks wait for startup to finish when you tap Start as the app opens
Shorter descriptions in network, DNS and general settings
Segmented controls follow the system's reduce motion setting
Screen readers can now switch the dashboard's outbound mode
On wider phones the top bar buttons line up with the list cards below them
Opening search puts the cursor in its field even when something else on the page has the focus
App icons in access control and connections load from the cache instead of being redrawn every day
On macOS, connections show the app that opened them again
A hidden window no longer takes the foreground from a full-screen game on Windows
The Linux window is no longer drawn shifted toward the bottom left on NVIDIA and other drivers without glBlitFramebuffer
When the menu bar or tray icon cannot be shown, the log says why
Intel Macs render with Skia again, fixing the hang at launch on older GPUs
Service checks show the address Claude and ChatGPT actually saw, not only the node's exit address
Gemini check no longer reports Hong Kong and Macau nodes as unsupported
macOS no longer collects defunct dscacheutil processes each time TUN is turned on or off
The default bypass list no longer skips the proxy for public 172.2* addresses, and the default fake-ip filter names Windows' real connectivity check hosts
Pages open and close again after the display sleeps or changes
Release files drop "dev" from their names, and the website lists every download again
Hold an app icon's room while it loads
Hold a remote icon's size while it loads and once it shows
Let the deb postrm remove a launcher link that is gone
Connections show the app's icon whenever the app is known
Process rules now match by default; "Always find process" looks up the process of every connection
Ask before turning on a module whose file cannot be read
Refresh trust after a partial certificate installation fails
Ask by the module file and write answers onto the current row
Let the v26 upgrade go on past a module file it cannot read
Answer the modules awaiting consent from their card
Keep whether a module awaits consent in its row
Head a capture that fails to read with its own words
Say when a gRPC frame is shown compressed for inflating too far
Tell a browser that holds the CA without trusting it apart on Linux
Ask before a module never agreed to runs what an update brings
Run a module's file deletions one at a time
End a long group tab where its more menu row ends
Keep long user names on one line beside their row's title
The editor shows its loading indicator as it opens instead of a blank page
The profile preview and editor opened from a sheet grow it to full height before scrolling
Installing or removing FlClash on Windows no longer closes FlClash rs
A mixed port of 0 is replaced by a working port and the app says so
A lost Core connection says so and stops the run instead of showing "core done"
An Android start that the VPN service gives up says why
A start that fails while applying the profile says why
The stopped core card says why the core stopped
Grouped requests open on the newest group
The tools page no longer opens scrolled to the bottom
Place the window with the target display's scale
Share links of HTTPUpgrade proxies no longer import as WebSocket
A macOS window shown from the tray stays on the current Space and a title-bar double click restores it from maximized; a Linux window drag starts from the press or touch that began it
Service status and exit IP checks no longer show a failure while the proxy starts, stops or changes network
Reopen WireGuard, Hysteria2 and TUIC links after a network change
Build the AppImage without a bundled libstdc++
Write a picked override key as it is, empty included
Protect core sockets opened before the Android VPN
Open sheets from a sheet as its next page
Success and warning colors are easier to read and calmer on banners and badges
Keep this machine's paths out of release binaries
Fade a profile card's press once the mouse drags off
Open the mixed port without a profile
The tools page no longer opens scrolled to its end
The profiles page opens on the selected profile without a jump
Large files open in the editor without a pause
Profiles with many rules, groups or proxies open and update without stalling the screen
The MITM page opens without a stutter the first time
Pages that load their data open at once with a spinner instead of pausing before they slide in
Use less battery on Android in the background
Open list editors and pages over others more smoothly
Smoother dashboard and tab switches, with one redraw a second while connected
Smoother proxy pages when switching groups, sorting and scrolling
Swiping back on phones drops fewer frames
Rank and sort connections off the UI isolate
Proxy and group icons use less memory on screens below 4x
